d: This role is being recruited in accordance with the Saudi Nationalization Scheme and as such we require a Saudi National for this opportunity
q: An experienced Compliance professional and Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO) to manage the State Street Saudi Arabia Financial Services (SSSAFS) Compliance and Financial Crimes programmes and provide Compliance advisory support to the SSSAFS business units. The individual will ideally have extensive knowledge of the Capital Market Authority (CMA) regulatory requirements and products offered to clients through SSSAFS. Experience in working in an international capital market institution is preferred.
Why this role is important to us

The team you will be joining plays an important role in the overall success of the organization. Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. To make that happen we need teams like yours to help navigate employees and the organization as a whole. In your role you will strive for cutting-edge solutions, that are straightforward and scalable. You will help us build resilience and execute day to day deliverables at our best. Join us if making your mark in the financial services industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.
CMA certificates: CME 1 and CME 2 are a must have
Working knowledge of SSSAFS business products and CMA regulatory requirements
8+ years of related experience including previous experience managing staff

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law.

r: Manage the assessment of Compliance and Financial Crimes risks.
Execute and deliver on the regulatory compliance oversight programme for SSSAFS, ensuring compliance with the Capital Market Authority (CMA) rules.

Develop and maintain good working relationships with the SSSAFS business, providing advisory support to assist with regulatory queries, and ensuring closure of any Compliance issues within a timely manner. Consult, advise and support management on compliance and regulatory matters that affect business decisions and the execution of their duties.
Act as Compliance and Financial Crimes representative in governance committees and forums.

Produce written reports for Senior Management on the Compliance risk opinion and delivery of the Compliance and Financial Crimes Compliance programmes for SSSAFS, indicating progress achieved and any significant matters requiring attention. Deliver the reports in governance committees and forums, as required.

Identify training needs and ensure successful implementation of Compliance and Financial Crimes training and education for all relevant staff within the SSSAFS business. Coordinate with the other locations to ensure consistency where appropriate.

Ensure the effective management of the local Compliance policy framework including review and input to regional/global policies, communication of policies and their key requirements to staff as required. This may include developing, implementing, promoting and maintaining compliance standards and procedures that require employees to act in a compliant manner.

Keep abreast of regulatory and legislative updates or changes, analyse and interpret the regulation and legislation (new and current as required). Provide de-brief and feedback to peers and business stakeholders as required. Contribute to the GRCM process, as required.
Play an active role in SSSAFS strategic initiatives, providing expertise on specific regulatory and compliance risks linked to specific projects.
Foster good relationships and manage ongoing interactions with the CMA (e.g. regulatory inspections, regulatory licences, registered individual applications, regulatory reporting, etc.).
These skills will help you succeed in this role

d: Title field: Assistant / Associate / Full Professor — Computer Studies (AI, Cybersecurity, Data Science, Networks, Mathematics, CS) Location: Dammam · Jeddah · Madinah · Riyadh, Saudi Arabia Workplace type: On-site / Hybrid · Employment type: Full-time

Description: EduGlobal Management has been exclusively retained by a leading accredited university in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia to recruit academic talent for its Faculty of Computer Studies. Appointments are available at Assistant Professor, Associate Professor and Professor rank across the Dammam, Jeddah, Madinah and Riyadh campuses. . The university’s preference that candidates are ENGLISH Speakers and earned PhD degree from a well reputable global western university in United States, Canada, Europe, Australia, and New Zealand.

The role You will teach undergraduate and graduate courses in your specialization and in related core computing subjects, contribute to curriculum development and program accreditation, and support high-quality, inclusive learning. The post combines teaching, academic advising, scholarship and departmental service — with the balance shifting toward research leadership and supervision at Associate Professor and Professor rank.
Key responsibilitiesDeliver lectures, labs, seminars, workshops and assessments
Prepare and update course materials using learner-centered teaching strategies
Evaluate student performance and maintain accurate academic records
Provide academic advising and student support
Contribute to curriculum development, program enhancement and accreditation
Conduct scholarly, applied or pedagogical research and publish in peer-reviewed venues
Supervise final-year projects; master’s and doctoral candidates at senior rank
Serve on departmental and faculty committees
At Professor rank: lead a research group, pursue external funding, mentor junior faculty

An earned PhD in the specialization applied for, awarded by a university ranked in the global top 500 by a recognized international ranking, and eligible for equivalency by the Saudi Ministry of Education.
A doctoral specialization that is a direct academic continuation of your bachelor’s and master’s fields and matches the post applied for
At least three years of university-level teaching experience gained after the doctorate
Advanced spoken and written English — the language of instruction; fluency assessed at interview
Demonstrated skill in instructional design, curriculum development and learner-centered pedagogy
Proficiency with educational technology and LMS platforms
Strong communication, organizational and time-management skills, and a commitment to inclusive teaching
Competitive tax-free salary, with rank and prior service recognized
Visa and residency permit fees fully covered for international hires
Eid holidays and Saudi Day public holidays
How to apply Complete the application form https://claude.ai/artifact/95ZahMzuRk3BKgXPC6iZro which covers the screening questions for every post in the faculty.
Email your CV and full publications list to Info@eduglobalmanagement.com, quoting the reference number the form gives you.
Shortlisted candidates are interviewed by the university’s search committee.

Applications are reviewed as they arrive and each post closes when filled.Please note: qualifications earned outside Saudi Arabia must be recognized by the Ministry of Education before an appointment is confirmed, and the attestation and equivalency chain routinely takes several months. Begin collecting certified degree documents at application stage rather than waiting for an offer.
